content: We have mass spec showing molecular ion m/z 193.1103. That suggests molecular weight ~193.11. The formula we got from candidate SMILES c1ccccc1CC(CO)C(=O)NC is C11H15NO2, calculate mass: C11=132.0, H15=15.12, N=14.01, O2=32.00 total ~193.13. Good match. So candidate fits mass. Need to confirm NMR maybe. Let's get proton NMR for that SMILES.
